fields.mechanism: Continuous monitoring of pressure variation exceeding a statistical threshold above baseline
fields.intervention: Implement a firmware algorithm in the retrofit module that calculates the standard deviation of real-time pressure sensor data and triggers an alarm when variation exceeds 2 SD above the established baseline, replacing static threshold logic.
fields.expected_effect: Detection of downstream occlusions at least ten minutes prior to conventional 400 mmHg threshold alarms, particularly at low flow rates, while minimizing false alarms caused by transient pressure spikes that do not exhibit sustained statistical deviation.
fields.falsification_test: Operate the retrofitted pump at 1 ml/h with a controlled downstream occlusion; if the device fails to alarm before the pressure reaches 400 mmHg or if it alarms during non-occluded operation with normal physiological pressure fluctuations, the mechanism is invalid.
fields.mechanism_source_span: The second algorithm continuously monitored whether the actual variation in the pressure exceeded a threshold of 2 standard deviations (SD) above the baseline pressure.

span_derivation.basis: shared content terms between span and mechanism+intervention; ratio < 0.20 = SPAN_UNDERIVED (the quoted span does not contain the mechanism's vocabulary)
